names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Ελευθέριος, Λεωνίδης και τα Άγια Νήπια», with the rank word left off. The page glosses the name: «Ο εραστής, κήρυκας και πρόμαχος της ελευθερίας».

Name page 759 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Елевферий, мч.»; the rank is stripped and the calendar gives no surname and no epithet, so the bare forename is the fullest form the source has and not a reconstruction. A DELIBERATE FOLD: `fk.mjs` returns `eleutherius-monk-martyr-1937`, which stores the identical bare form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 августа ст. ст. — «Мчч. Елевферия и Леонида (IV).»

attestations.note: The first of the two names in the day's seventh entry, and the same menologion day as the folder's Greek row, which is its only other venerated one. THE HOLY INFANTS ARE OWED NOTHING: `holy-infants-with-eleutherius-and-leonides` stands on the Greek 8 August and this Russian line names no infants, so no row was written for them. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN: the line's «(IV)» is the fourth century and would be this folder's first date of any kind — the standing author question — and the reading life4401, shared with his companion, was not opened. THE `ru` FORM FOLDS ONTO `eleutherius-monk-martyr-1937`, a twentieth-century monastic kept on the Julian 14 August who stores the same bare «Елевферий»; the fold is recorded in the gate's READ_FOLDS. The day page prints no hymn under either name.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Ελευθέριος, Λεωνίδης και τα Άγια Νήπια»

attestations.note: One listing line carries three parties — Eleutherius, Leonides and the Holy Infants — and the one life page behind it names the two men and enumerates nobody among the infants, so by the synaxis rule the two named men are two folders and the unenumerated company is a third. The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on it. It prints no year, no country, no hymn of any kind, and nothing of the two men's own story beyond the manner of their death and the place of the synaxis.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
